**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding AP. Section 1 affirmatively states the arrangement is non-exclusive and preserves AP's freedom to offer or sell Inventory via other agents or third parties. The only negative covenants on AP are routine platform-use restrictions (no third-party access, no derivative works) and standard confidentiality undertakings, neither of which restricts the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. This sits at the playbook's preferred position.
